scope: Independent read-only source and control review of a pure evaluation helper; no context assembly or runtime trial repeated.
findings: Original declared requirements and original, declared and active obligation denominators remain separate; a baseline without those declarations gains no route denominator.
A selected unit is checked against its exact complete-record hash; lexical selection alone is not counted as a retained navigation route.
Restored routes and inferred associations have separate denominators and retained counts; directions, path length, unique records and returned endpoints are checked.

The reported missing/weakened-terminal-guard gap is repaired: every returned terminal migration edge must carry the exact guard declared in the ledger, while legitimately unguarded original prefixes remain valid.

Supplied obligation records, altered original requirements, unsupported legacy completion claims and unknown route derivations reject. Empty/refused packages preserve declared uncertainty and obligations.

Ten source controls were reviewed, including missing/weakened terminal guards and an unguarded-prefix positive. Author reports10/10 passing plus a real-ledger empty-package check; these were not rerun by this reviewer.
limits: This helper measures delivery of declared research navigation; it does not establish legal relevance, rule completeness or specialist acceptance.
Whole runtime replay and final source/evaluation acceptance are separate gates.
